Definition: from G3303 and G5104; indeed though, i.e. however:--also, but, howbeit, nevertheless, yet.
BiblicalUsage: Mentoi means nevertheless, yet, howbeit, the word that holds the line when everything else gives way. 2 Timothy 2:19 says, Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, and James 2:8 says, If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe 'nevertheless' is the believer's hinge: the foundation stands sure whatever else shakes.
